paite: Huan huai nung in Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron alut ua, "Hichibang in Israelte' TOUPA Pathian in achi. Gamdai a kei a dia ankuangluina abawltheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in," chi in ahilh uhi.
heading: Aigupta Kumpipa Pharaoh Ma Ah Mosi Leh Aaron
english: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”

paite: Pharaoh in, "Israelte paisak ding a a-aw ka man ding, huai TOUPA kua ahia? Hiai TOUPA ka thei kei, Israelte leng ka paisak kei ding," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”

paite: Huchi in amau, "Hebrute' Pathian in ahon kimuhpih a; gamdai ah ni thum lam ah, hon paisak in, ka hon ngen uhi. TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah hon kithoihsak in. Hipi hiam, namsau hiam in ahon gawt kha ding hi,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”

paite: Aigupta kumpipa'n akiang uah, - "Mosi leh Aaron, bangziak a noute'n mite nasep khawlsak na hi ua? Na puakgikte uh pua un," achi hi.
english: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”

paite: Pharaoh in, "Ngai un, gam a mite tu in atam ua, apuakgik ua pan na khawlsak uhi,” achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”

paite: Pharaoh in huai ni mah in mite' nasem heutute leh upate thu apia hi.
english: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,

paite: "Tuma siah a bang in teklei bawlna ding in mite buhpawl na pe nawn kei iding uhi. Kuan uhenla, buhpawl va - kilak uhen.
english: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

paite: Tuma siah ateklei bawlsa tengteng uh, atung uah na koih ding a; huai a pan in bangmah na kiamsak kei iding uhi. Atha uh adah kha dia; huchi in kap in, ka Pathian kiang uah hon paisak inla, hon va kithoihsak in, achi kha ding uh.
english: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’

paite: Nna tamsem atung uah guan unla, asepgim theihna ding un; thugina lou limsak kei uhen,” achi hi.
english: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”

paite: Mite nasem heutute apaikhia ua, a-upate uh toh, mite kiang ah thu agen ua, "Pharoah in buhpawl ahon pe kei ding.
english: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.

paite: "Nouskuan unla, na muh theihtheihna uah buhpawl kilak un. Himahleh na nasep uh bangmah kiamsak ahi kei ding," achi uhi.
english: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”

paite: Mite buhpawl sik a buhbul lakhawm ding in Aigupta gam teng ah avak zakta uhi.
english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

paite: Nasem heutute'n amau anoh ua, na nasep uh zou un, na niteng sep dingte uh, buhpawl a-om lai in, achi uhi.
english: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”

paite: Israel suan upate, Pharaoh nasem heutute atung ua akoihte un, avua ua, bangziak a tuma lam a bang a zan leh tuni a na teklei bawl uh zou lou na hi ua? chi in aphutluih uhi.
english: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”

paite: Huaitak in Israel suan upate ahong ua, Pharaoh kiang ah akap ua, "Bangziak a na sikhate hichi bawl tel na hia?
english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?

paite: Na sikhate buhpawl piak ka hi kei ua, amau lah ka kiang uah, 'Teklei bawl un!' ahon chi uh. Ngai in, na sikhate vuak in ka om ua, amoh na mite ahi uh," achi uhi.
english: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n, “Thadah na hi uh, thadah na hi uh. Huaiziak in nou, 'Pai ni in, TOUPA kiang ah va kithoih ni,' na chi uhi.
english: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to Yahweh.’

paite: Huaiziak in kuan unla; nna va sem un. Pawl ahon kipe kei dia, himahleh teklei bikhiah zah na piakkhiak ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”

paite: Na niteng nasep ua na tekleite ua pan bangmah na kiamsak ding uh ahi kei, akichih nung Israel suan upate'n thusia om ahihdan atheita uhi.
english: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”

paite: Pharaoh a pan ahong paikhiak un lampi a dingh Mosi leh Aaron akituahpih uhi.
english: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.

paite: Akiang uah, "TOUPA'N nou hon en in vai hawm hen. Pharaoh mit leh asikhate mit in ka gimnam uh kihhuai in na bawl ua, koute hon that dia akhut ua namsau na koih tak ziak un," achi uhi.
english: They said to them, “May Yahweh look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akik nawn a, "Toupa, bangziak a hiai mite hichibang a gilou suaksak na hia? Bangziak a kei hon sawl na hia?
heading: Pathian Kiang Ah Mosi Aphun
english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?

paite: Na min a thu gen dia Pharaoh kiang a ka va hoh nungsiah lah, ama'n hiai mite tung ah gilou abawl ngal a. Na mite lah na pikhe ngal kei a," achi hi.
english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”
